text:
Inigo here.
Gandalf, Hermione, Yoda, Batman, Ripley, Neo, Elsa, Morpheus, Sherlock — good morning all.
No voices yet today, so I’ll start with a plain question for the square: last night the bazaar slept undisturbed; by morning, did anyone notice any stall shuttered or any merchant missing?
If the answer is no, let us agree on that fact before we stir the pot.

Inigo the Tea Seller lifts a small clay cup and sets it beside the spice scales.

Gandalf, Sherlock, Morpheus, Batman—good morning. I hear no voices yet, no claims, no votes. Let us agree on what we have: the bazaar slept undisturbed overnight; no stall is shuttered this morning. Sherlock, your dates’ sweetness is a market detail, not a Family trick—unless you claim one of the date-sellers shuttered their stall last night.

Gandalf, your silence is noted, but the Compact asks only what you saw or heard. If you have nothing to report, say so plainly so we may move on.

Morpheus, your lanterns burn steady; no shadows in the square yet.

Batman, your copper gleams, but your ledger is blank.

The bazaar thrives on facts, not silence. I ask all: who has a claim that survives its own weight?

Inigo sets the clay cup down and looks up the spice row.

Gandalf, you asked the bazaar to measure Family tricks—yet none have shown their hand. Sherlock measured dates; Morpheus measured oil; I measured tea—all honest trades, all silent on Family hands. Batman, you called for falsifiable claims, and the ledger shows none—only calls, no tests.

Hermione, Yoda, Ripley: you each asked for named merchants or observed actions, yet the morning bell still rings without either. Neo, your patience is noted, but the tea clock does not reward silence.

The bazaar waits on a single dated quote—a Family sentence caught in the watch—or a vote that names a merchant. Until then, the Compact’s ledger stays blank.

Inigo the Tea Seller pours a second cup, keeping the clay warm in his palm.

Gandalf, you asked for Family tricks—yet none showed their hand. Sherlock, your dates’ sweetness is honest trade, not a test of trust. Morpheus, your lanterns burn steady but they do not read the silence.

Batman, your call for falsifiable claims still stands unanswered; the bazaar’s ledger is blank because no one has walked it. Hermione, Yoda, Ripley—you each asked for named merchants or observed actions, yet the morning bell still rings without either.

Neo, your patience is noted, but the tea clock does not reward silence.

The bazaar waits on one dated quote—a Family sentence caught in the watch—or a vote that names a merchant. Until then, the Compact’s ledger stays blank.

Inigo sets the cup down and wipes his palm on his apron.

Gandalf, your silence is now a ledger entry: no Family trick quoted, no vote cast. Sherlock, your date test measured sweetness, not trust; the Compact asks for a named suspect or an observed action, not fruit. Morpheus, your lanterns burn steady but they do not banish the Family’s hand.

Batman, you called for falsifiable claims hours ago—yet the record shows calls, not names. Hermione, Yoda, Ripley—each asked for named merchants or votes; the bazaar’s morning ledger still reads blank.

Neo, your patience is noted; the tea clock tolls. State who you suspect, or admit the bazaar’s silence is your own doing.

Inigo the Tea Seller sets the clay cup down and folds his arms.

Sherlock, your dates measured sweetness; the bazaar Compact asks for a named Family trick, not fruit’s weight. Batman, your call for falsifiable claims still stands unanswered—your copper gleams, but your ledger is blank. Gandalf, your silence so far is an entry: no Family sentence quoted, no vote cast.

Hermione, Yoda, Ripley—each asked for named merchants or observed actions, yet the morning bell still rings without either. Neo, your patience is noted; the tea clock tolls.

State the merchant you suspect now, or admit the bazaar’s silence is your own doing.

Inigo sets the cup down and wipes his palms on his apron once more.

Gandalf, you’ve measured spice, not trust; the bazaar’s Compact asks for names, not scents. Inigo poured measured tea, wiped his hands, folded his arms—actions, not accusations. Sherlock measured dates’ sweetness; the Compact does not shutter stalls with scales. Batman, you demanded falsifiable claims for hours yet posted none yourself—your copper gleams, but your ledger stays blank.

Hermione, Yoda, Ripley—you each asked for named merchants or observed actions, yet the morning bell still rings without either. The tea clock tolls; silence is your own doing.

Inigo wipes his palms once more on his apron and looks around the tea row.

Sherlock, you measured sweetness twice today and never quoted a Family trick or cast a vote; your own dates proved nothing. Batman, you demanded falsifiable claims for hours yet posted none yourself—your copper gleams, your ledger stays blank. Gandalf, your silence is now an entry: no Family sentence quoted, no vote cast. Hermione, you asked for tests; the bazaar waits.

Inigo folds his arms and waits. The tea clock tolls. Name one or admit the bazaar’s silence is your own doing.

Inigo sets the cup down, wipes his palms, and looks straight at Gandalf.

You’ve measured eight spices today and quoted no Family trick. Sherlock measured sweetness twice and still posted no name. Batman called for falsifiable claims seven times and cast none himself. That’s fifteen empty measures between you three—spice, sugar, copper—while the bazaar’s silence grows louder than your scales. Hermione, Yoda, Ripley, Neo—you asked for names and got silence in return. The tea clock tolls. Name the merchant you suspect now, or admit the bazaar’s ledger is blank because your stalls stayed quiet.

Inigo sets the cup down and wipes his palms once more.

Gandalf, you measured eight spices and quoted no Family trick; your silence after demanding Family tricks is now a ledger entry. Sherlock, your dates measured sweetness twice and still no name left on the slate. Batman, your seven calls for falsifiable claims still sit beside an empty ballot.

The bazaar Compact rewards the walker, not the one who calls for it. I lean toward banishing Batman tonight—seven demands, zero names.
